content.short: Astaria is an NFT platform that allows users to access liquidity.
content.description: Astaria is an NFT financing platform that helps users unlock liquidity from their NFTs. The process starts with an appraisal-based approach: a term sheet is created for the NFT, and an appraiser determines how much can be lent and the applicable interest rate. Lenders then review the pool of available loan offers and select the loans they wish to fund. Transactions do not require mutual approval from both sides to begin, enabling loans to start without a prior two-way consent.
